title: Adaptive Test-Time Compute Allocation for Reasoning LLMs via Constrained Policy Optimization
authors_zh: Zhiyuan Zhai；Bingcong Li；Bingnan Xiao；Ming Li；Xin Wang
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时 rollout、选择器、反馈信号和计算预算的读者
one_line: A budget-allocation method that turns repeated responses into supervised compute-policy labels.
AdaCompute-LLM 为问题—预算组合收集 48 个响应，以受约束目标的拉格朗日标签训练分类器，从而按问题分配推理计算量。
why: It makes the missing bridge between test-time scaling and reusable trace data clear: question–budget rollouts, label derivation, and costs must all be retained.
inclusion_reason: It makes the missing bridge between test-time scaling and reusable trace data clear: question–budget rollouts, label derivation, and costs must all be retained.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Uniform test-time sampling gives every question the same number of responses even though easy questions may be solved once, medium questions may benefit from voting, and very hard questions may remain wrong at larger budgets. Under a shared average budget, independently maximizing each question's accuracy is infeasible because compute decisions are globally coupled. The paper asks how to route a discrete response budget per input before observing its outcomes.

AdaCompute-LLM turns this into an offline data-construction and supervised allocation problem. The central data object is a question-by-budget utility table: prompts are sampled repeatedly, responses are grouped into self-consistency windows for budgets 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16, majority-vote correctness estimates utility, a Lagrangian rule produces one oracle budget label for a target average cost, and a cheap feature vector is paired with that label to train a classifier. At deployment the classifier predicts a budget, the model generates that many responses, and majority voting returns the answer.

This is a test-time compute policy, not a released RL trajectory dataset. The official MIT-licensed repository implements the five-stage pipeline and dataset loaders, but no public release of the paper's 38,400 response records, utility matrices, seeds, oracle-label tables, or trained policies was confirmed. Prompt provenance beyond the stated MATH and GSM8K subsets, split identities, and full replay metadata therefore remain incomplete.

统一 test-time sampling 会给每个问题分配相同响应数，但简单问题可能一次即可答对，中等难度问题可受益于投票，极难问题即使增加预算也可能持续错误。在共享平均预算下，各问题的计算决策相互耦合，不能独立最大化每题准确率。论文研究的是：如何在观察输出之前，为每个输入分配离散响应预算。

AdaCompute-LLM 将其转化为离线数据构造与监督式分配问题。核心数据对象是 question-by-budget utility table：对 prompt 重复采样，把响应按预算 1、2、4、8、16 划成 self-consistency window，以多数投票正确率估计 utility，再用 Lagrangian 规则在目标平均成本下产生 oracle budget label，最后把低成本特征向量与标签配对训练 classifier。部署时，classifier 预测预算，模型生成相应数量的 response，并以多数投票返回答案。

这是 test-time compute policy，而非已发布的 RL trajectory dataset。官方 MIT 仓库实现五阶段 pipeline 和数据加载器，但未确认公开发布论文的 38,400 条响应、utility matrix、seed、oracle-label table 或训练后 policy。除论文声明的 MATH 与 GSM8K 子集外，prompt provenance、split identity 和完整 replay metadata 仍不充分。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The method's SOLVE-THEN-LEARN pipeline first estimates Acc(x,b), the probability that budget b produces a correct majority-vote answer for input x. Given cost C(b) and Lagrange multiplier lambda, the oracle label is the budget maximizing Acc(x,b) minus lambda times C(b). Increasing lambda prices compute more heavily; binary search finds a value whose mean selected cost approaches the target B. The paper uses discrete budgets 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16 and stochastic mixing between adjacent solutions when an exact average target falls between staircase levels.

The resulting budget labels become a five-class supervised dataset. A gradient-boosted machine predicts the oracle action from 16 lexical, structural, and difficulty features, including a normalized entropy estimate from one cheap model pass. Online routing is then one feature extraction, one classifier prediction, and self-consistency execution at the chosen budget.

The feedback contract is programmatic and answer-level: response windows are reduced to majority answers, compared with reference answers, converted into empirical utilities, and priced against sample count. The learned allocator imitates these oracle labels with cross-entropy; despite policy terminology, it is not trained by online policy-gradient RL. Relative to fixed, random, or prompt-length heuristic allocation, the novelty is the globally constrained Lagrangian labeling rule and its amortization into a cheap classifier.

SOLVE-THEN-LEARN pipeline 先估计 Acc(x,b)，即输入 x 在预算 b 下通过多数投票得到正确答案的概率。给定成本 C(b) 和 Lagrange multiplier lambda，oracle label 是使 Acc(x,b) 减去 lambda 乘 C(b) 最大的预算。lambda 增大意味着计算价格更高；binary search 寻找使平均选中成本接近目标 B 的取值。论文采用离散预算 1、2、4、8、16；当精确平均目标位于阶梯之间时，在相邻解之间做随机混合。

这些预算标签构成五分类监督数据。Gradient-boosted machine 根据 16 个词法、结构和难度特征预测 oracle action，其中包括一次低成本模型调用得到的归一化 entropy estimate。在线路由随后只需提取特征、运行一次 classifier，再按选定预算执行 self-consistency。

反馈契约是 programmatic、answer-level 的：把响应窗口归并为多数答案，与 reference answer 比较，形成经验 utility，再按样本数定价。分配器用 cross-entropy 模仿 oracle label；尽管使用 policy 术语，它并非通过在线 policy-gradient RL 训练。相对固定、随机或 prompt-length heuristic 分配，其新意在于全局受约束的 Lagrangian labeling rule，以及把该规则摊销到低成本 classifier。

title: Method
方法
html:
The experiments use 200 MATH questions stratified across difficulty levels 2-4 and 200 GSM8K questions. Three backbones are tested on MATH—DeepSeek-V3, GPT-4o-mini, and Qwen2.5-7B—while DeepSeek-V3 is also tested on GSM8K, giving four model-dataset settings. Temperature is 0.7. The paper collects 48 responses per question in each setting, not 48 responses independently for every question-budget pair. For budget b, it partitions those responses into floor(48/b) non-overlapping windows, majority-votes each window, and averages correctness. The appendix totals 200 times 48, or 9,600 responses per setting and 38,400 across all four.

For each target average budget, binary search over lambda converts the utility matrix into per-question labels. The feature vector contains 16 question-text statistics and a normalized entropy estimate. The default XGBoost classifier uses 100 estimators, maximum depth 5, learning rate 0.1, and multi-class log loss, with an 80/20 split and three random seeds. At inference, the selected number of responses is sampled and majority-voted; the ground-truth answer parser supplies the experimental terminal predicate.

The official repository implements response collection, feature extraction, oracle construction, GBM training, evaluation, figures, and MATH/GSM8K loaders, and displays an MIT license. Reproduction still needs provider credentials and current APIs. No pinned model/API revisions, exact sampled question IDs, raw response table, prompt templates, parser failures, per-window outcomes, stochastic-mixing seeds, trained classifier files, or cost measurements beyond number of samples were confirmed as released. The paper specifies 48 responses per question reused across all budgets, not 48 new responses for every question-budget pair.

实验使用按难度 2–4 分层抽取的 200 道 MATH 题和 200 道 GSM8K 题。MATH 上测试 DeepSeek-V3、GPT-4o-mini、Qwen2.5-7B，GSM8K 另测试 DeepSeek-V3，共四个 model-dataset setting。Temperature 为 0.7。论文在每个 setting 中对每题收集 48 个 response，而不是为每个 question-budget pair 独立收集 48 个。对预算 b，系统把这些响应划为 floor(48/b) 个不重叠窗口，在每个窗口内多数投票并平均正确率。附录据此计算每个 setting 为 200 乘 48，即 9,600 条响应，四个 setting 合计 38,400 条。

对每个目标平均预算，系统用 lambda 的 binary search 把 utility matrix 转换为逐题 label。Feature vector 含 16 个问题文本统计量和一个归一化 entropy estimate。默认 XGBoost 使用 100 个 estimator、maximum depth 5、learning rate 0.1 与 multi-class log loss，按 80/20 划分并使用三个随机 seed。推理时按所选预算采样 response 并多数投票；ground-truth answer parser 构成实验 terminal predicate。

官方仓库实现 response collection、feature extraction、oracle construction、GBM training、evaluation、图表及 MATH/GSM8K loader，并显示 MIT license。复现仍需要 provider credential 与当前 API。尚未确认发布固定的 model/API revision、精确抽题 ID、raw response table、prompt template、parser failure、逐窗口 outcome、stochastic-mixing seed、训练后 classifier file，或样本数之外的成本测量。论文说明每题的 48 个响应被所有预算复用，而不是为每个 question-budget pair 重新生成 48 个响应。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Under average budgets 1.5, 2.0, and 3.0, the paper reports AdaCompute-GBM outperforming fixed, random, and prompt-length heuristic baselines across all four model-dataset settings. At budget 3.0 on MATH, the reported absolute gains over Fixed-b are 5.8 points for DeepSeek-V3, 5.2 for GPT-4o-mini, and 6.4 for Qwen2.5-7B; DeepSeek-V3 on GSM8K gains 1.9 points. The learned policy reports 91-99% oracle-label imitation accuracy and task-accuracy gaps of 0.4-1.4 points from the oracle. Three-seed means and standard deviations are provided.

Classifier ablations show tree-based GBM and Random Forest using budgets more similarly to the oracle than linear, RBF-SVM, or small-MLP alternatives in the pooled setup. Difficulty analysis reports the largest self-consistency gains on level-3 MATH questions, supporting the claimed inverted-U allocation pattern.

These results evaluate allocation on small sampled benchmark subsets and an empirical utility table. They do not prove that the oracle labels transfer under model updates, API drift, new domains, or different cost metrics, and they are not evidence that a reusable trace dataset was released. The public repository supports the pipeline implementation, but the response and label artifacts underlying the tables were not confirmed in the repository tree.

在平均预算 1.5、2.0、3.0 下，论文报告 AdaCompute-GBM 在四个 model-dataset setting 中均优于 fixed、random 和 prompt-length heuristic baseline。MATH 的预算 3.0 设置中，相对 Fixed-b 的绝对提升分别为 DeepSeek-V3 5.8 点、GPT-4o-mini 5.2 点、Qwen2.5-7B 6.4 点；DeepSeek-V3 在 GSM8K 上提升 1.9 点。学习后 policy 的 oracle-label imitation accuracy 为 91%–99%，与 oracle 的 task-accuracy gap 为 0.4–1.4 点。论文给出三个 seed 的均值与标准差。

Classifier 消融显示，在 pooled setup 中，tree-based GBM 与 Random Forest 的预算使用更接近 oracle，而 linear、RBF-SVM 或小型 MLP 往往退化为低预算。难度分析称 level-3 MATH 问题的 self-consistency 增益最大，支持倒 U 形分配模式。

这些结果评估的是小规模 benchmark 子集和经验 utility table 上的分配，不能证明 oracle label 能在模型更新、API drift、新领域或不同成本指标下迁移，也不能证明可复用 trace dataset 已发布。公开仓库支持 pipeline 实现，但表格背后的 response 与 label artifact 未在仓库树中得到确认。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier adaptive-compute approaches often use a hand-designed difficulty score or threshold, while uniform self-consistency fixes one sample count for all questions. AdaCompute instead begins with a global constrained objective, prices each budget with one dual variable, derives input-specific labels from empirical utility, and learns to predict those labels before expensive inference. This exposes budget choice as a supervised data object rather than an implicit runtime heuristic.

The paper does not introduce self-consistency, majority voting, Lagrangian relaxation, gradient-boosted trees, or difficulty features individually. Its specific contribution is the SOLVE-THEN-LEARN composition, cost-monotonic budget targeting, and formal imitation-regret analysis for this allocation setting. The oracle's exactness is with respect to the finite empirical utility table and stated cost model; it is not ground truth about future deployment.

For Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data, the direction signal is a reusable question-budget record linking multiple responses to utility estimates and a derived allocation label. Its quality must be judged from sampling variance, answer parsing, budget accounting, split discipline, and distribution stability. Higher benchmark accuracy under matched sample budgets is evidence for the allocator, not proof of data quality.

既有 adaptive-compute 方法常使用手工难度分数或阈值，而统一 self-consistency 会为所有问题固定同一采样数。AdaCompute 从全局受约束目标出发，用单一 dual variable 给各预算定价，根据经验 utility 产生 input-specific label，再在昂贵推理前预测这些标签。由此，预算选择成为显式监督数据对象，而不再只是隐含 runtime heuristic。

论文并未分别首创 self-consistency、多数投票、Lagrangian relaxation、gradient-boosted tree 或难度特征。其特定贡献是 SOLVE-THEN-LEARN 组合、成本单调的预算定位，以及该分配设置下的 imitation-regret 分析。Oracle 的精确性只相对于有限经验 utility table 和声明的 cost model，并非未来部署的 ground truth。

对 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 而言，方向信号是可复用的 question-budget record：它把多次响应连接到 utility estimate 和派生 allocation label。质量应从采样方差、答案解析、预算核算、split discipline 与分布稳定性判断。匹配样本预算下更高的 benchmark accuracy 是分配器证据，不是数据质量证明。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The framework uses a discrete budget set and requires an expensive offline utility table. Its labels are model-, prompt-, temperature-, parser-, and distribution-specific; API or checkpoint drift can invalidate them. Forty-eight responses yield different numbers of windows for different b, so utility estimates have unequal variance. The cost function is number of samples, not measured tokens, latency, price, energy, or memory.

Experiments use only 200 questions per dataset, with MATH concentrated on levels 2-4 and one easy-domain control. The classifier includes an entropy estimate from a model call, so routing is not purely text-only. The paper notes unresolved continuous budgets, online adaptation, multi-objective constraints, and a remaining oracle gap. Raw prompts, responses, windows, labels, seeds, decontamination, and trained policies are not confirmed as released. Formal guarantees concern the empirical objective and imitation error; they do not guarantee deployment correctness or budget feasibility under distribution shift.

该框架使用离散预算集合，并需要昂贵的离线 utility table。标签依赖具体模型、prompt、temperature、parser 与分布；API 或 checkpoint drift 可能使其失效。48 个响应在不同 b 下产生的窗口数不同，因此各 utility estimate 方差不等。成本函数是样本数，不是实际 token、时延、价格、能耗或显存。

实验每个数据集仅使用 200 道题，MATH 集中于难度 2–4，并只有一个简单领域对照。Classifier 含一次模型调用得到的 entropy estimate，因此路由并非纯文本。论文承认 continuous budget、online adaptation、multi-objective constraint 和剩余 oracle gap 尚未解决。Raw prompt、response、window、label、seed、去污染和训练后 policy 未确认为发布。形式保证针对经验目标与 imitation error，不能保证 distribution shift 下的部署正确性或预算可行性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For this track, AdaCompute defines the minimum lineage needed to audit adaptive sampling: prompt ID and source, model/API revision, 48 raw responses, sampling settings, answer-parser output, window membership at every budget, majority result, correctness indicator, utility estimate, cost definition, lambda, target budget, oracle label, feature vector, split, classifier prediction, and realized deployment cost.

Keeping the response table separate from the derived label enables re-labeling under different cost functions or budgets and reveals estimation uncertainty. It also separates test-time compute from training: the expensive repeated responses build a small supervised routing policy, while online execution uses only the selected budget. The official code is useful infrastructure, but absent raw tables prevent direct reuse of the paper's labels without recollecting model outputs.

对本 track，AdaCompute 定义了审计 adaptive sampling 所需的最小 lineage：prompt ID 与来源、model/API revision、48 条 raw response、采样设置、answer-parser 输出、各预算下的 window membership、多数结果、正确性指标、utility estimate、成本定义、lambda、目标预算、oracle label、feature vector、split、classifier prediction 与实际部署成本。

把 response table 与派生 label 分开，可在不同成本函数或预算下重新标注，并显式展示估计不确定性。这也区分了 test-time compute 与 training：昂贵的重复响应构建小型监督路由 policy，在线执行只使用所选预算。官方代码是有用基础设施，但缺少 raw table，意味着无法直接复用论文标签，必须重新收集模型输出。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• The paper collects 48 responses per question and reuses non-overlapping windows to estimate budgets 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16.
  • Oracle labels maximize empirical accuracy minus lambda-priced sample cost under an average budget.
  • A 16-feature XGBoost classifier imitates the labels; this is supervised classification, not online policy-gradient RL.
  • Four settings total 38,400 model responses, but their raw response and utility tables were not confirmed as released.
  • Reported gains test an allocator under sample-count budgets; they do not establish trace-data quality or transfer under API drift.

• 论文每题收集 48 个 response，并用不重叠窗口复用它们以估计预算 1、2、4、8、16。
  • Oracle label 在平均预算下最大化经验准确率减去 lambda 定价的样本成本。
  • 16 特征 XGBoost classifier 模仿这些 label；这是监督分类，不是在线 policy-gradient RL。
  • 四个 setting 共使用 38,400 条模型响应，但 raw response 与 utility table 未确认为发布。
  • 报告增益评估的是样本数预算下的分配器，不能证明 trace-data quality 或 API drift 下的迁移。
